Draw the actual intended rectangle and choose its centre through the UI, then Save and verify the new Indoor row. Use the supplied coordinates only as historical fictional observations, not as a real site plan.
Layers: use floor name TRAINING ONLY - Ground floor, order0, Floor Plan; select the supplied PNG with the normal file chooser and Add Layer.
Verify Has Image Yes and Tiled No, then open Region Editor and wait for the actual image.

Draw a rectangle within Briefing room. Name Briefing area - training, Type Room, Color#3388ff, Description Fictional team briefing room for this software exercise., Searchable true, Dispatchable true. Save Region.
After reload select the actual polygon, not the list label, to reopen saved properties.
Rename Briefing room - training, Color#006f83, Searchable true, Dispatchable false; Save Region. Reopen polygon and verify teal, saved values and missing Dispatchable badge.
Return to the intended map Edit and verify the saved type/name/description/bounds; do not Save a duplicate.
